sources.credit: Romanian National Heritage Institute (CIMEC) photograph archive
sources.observation: The fortress occupies the crest of an abrupt limestone hill. The ground is steep and exposed rock alternates with grass and woods.
The aerial crop establishes the shape of the hilltop clearing, its position within the mapped site, and its relationship to the surrounding woodland.

limitations: The mapped wall and foundation-remains zones locate the fragments. Their individual positions, dimensions and heights are representative. The enclosing protected polygon identifies the broader site.
